definitions.explanation: Artists' paint in which the pigment is suspended in oil rather than water. It dries slowly and produces rich, durable colors. Built from {油性|ゆせい} (oil-based) + {絵具|えのぐ} (paint, pigment).

examples.english: I painted a picture with oil paints.

examples.japanese: {油性絵具|ゆせいえのぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: Oil paints take a long time to dry.

examples.japanese: {油性絵具|ゆせいえのぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{重|かさ}ね{塗|ぬ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{深|ふか}み→深み：13333_fukami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{色合|いろあ}い→色合い：13950_iroai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|だ}せる→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Because oil paints can be layered, you can achieve colors with great depth.

notes:
Artists' paint bound with oil, used for oil painting on canvas. It is thinned and cleaned with solvents rather than water.

- {油性絵具|ゆせいえのぐ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to paint with oil paints
